name: beautiful-android
description: Write, review, port, and enforce idiomatic native Android apps in Kotlin + Jetpack Compose: three skills distilled from the Android developer documentation, the Compose guidance, and the facta Android handbook, plus a drop-in detekt and ktlint config.

interface.longDescription:
Three skills for native Android developers on Kotlin + Jetpack Compose, distilled from the Android developer documentation, the Compose guidance, and the facta Android handbook.

android-best-practices guides new native code: the sacred main thread, Gradle modules that enforce the domain/data/ui/app layers, UDF with UiState/UiEvent/effects, Navigation 3 and validated deep links, Room/DataStore and the WorkManager outbox, FCM, Keystore secrets, baseline/startup profiles and the low-end performance budget.

android-review reviews a Compose screen, ViewModel, module graph, Room/WorkManager path, deep link, FCM handler, or diff and returns a prioritized report. Architecture and main-thread contracts rank above everything. Every finding cites a file and line, the rule it breaks, and the smallest fix.

android-port ports a React Native, web, Java/XML Views or legacy screen to Kotlin + Compose with the same behavior. It ports the original tests first and writes a PORTING.md.

The skills contain instructions and reference text only. They make no network calls and collect no data. When a Gradle/Kotlin toolchain is available, the skills run Gradle test, detekt, and lint on your project; without one, they work from the code alone. A drop-in detekt and ktlint config is available in the GitHub repository.
capabilities: Review Android code with cited rules
Port RN, web or Views screens to Compose
defaultPrompt: Review this Compose screen and list what to fix first
Port this React Native screen to Kotlin + Compose
Move this Room query off the main thread

publication.release_notes: Initial release: three Android skills, the module and main-thread contract, and a proven detekt config.
